records.jp: よし、これで準備万端だね
records.en_original: Okay, I think we're all set!
records.en: Okay, I think we're all set!

records.jp: 待って！<CR>映画のお供がないよ！
records.en_original: Wait! We don't have anything to go with the movie!
records.en: Wait! We don't have anything to go with the movie!

records.jp: 映画のお供？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: ポップコーンとかさ
records.en_original: You know, popcorn and stuff!
records.en: You know, popcorn and stuff!

records.jp: ああ、映画館で売ってる……<CR>ああいうの食べきれたことないんだよね
records.en_original: Ahh, like they sell at movie theaters... I can never finish those.
records.en: Ahh, like they sell at movie theaters... I can never finish those.

records.jp: 自分で量を調節できるのがホームシアターのいいところ
records.en_original: That's what's good about home theaters, you can make as much or as little as you want!
records.en: That's what's good about home theaters, you can make as much or as little as you want!

records.jp: ホーム？　まぁ、ホームか。<CR>じゃあ、何にしようかな
records.en_original: Home? I mean...I guess you could call this home. So, what should we make?
records.en: Home? I mean...I guess you could call this home. So, what should we make?

records.jp: ポップコーンは？<CR>やっぱ映画といえばこれっしょ
records.en_original: If we're gonna watch a movie, it's gotta be popcorn, right?
records.en: If we're gonna watch a movie, it's gotta be popcorn, right?

records.jp: まあね。一個一個もそんなに多くないし
records.en_original: I guess so. And it's not too filling.
records.en: I guess so. And it's not too filling.

records.jp: コンロに直接火をかけて作るの、<CR>あったらやりたいなぁ
records.en_original: I've always wanted to try making popcorn on the stove.
records.en: I've always wanted to try making popcorn on the stove.

records.jp: 中々一人だと手を出す勇気がなくて
records.en_original: But I'm too nervous to try it by myself.
records.en: But I'm too nervous to try it by myself.

records.jp: よっしゃ！　探しにいこう！
records.en_original: All right, then! Let's go look for some!
records.en: All right, then! Let's go look for some!

records.jp: おにぎりは？
records.en_original: How about rice balls?
records.en: How about rice balls?

records.jp: おにぎり！？
records.en_original: Rice balls?!
records.en: Rice balls?!

records.jp: 映画館の売店で売ってるの見たことなくない？
records.en_original: Have you ever seen a movie theater that has rice balls at the concession stand?
records.en: Have you ever seen a movie theater that has rice balls at the concession stand?

records.jp: ないけど
思ったことない？<CR>たまには和っぽいものを食べながら映画見たいって
records.en_original: Exactly. Don't you ever feel like eating something a bit more Japanese while watching a movie?
records.en: Exactly. Don't you ever feel like eating something a bit more Japanese while watching a movie?

records.jp: 確かに、もうちょっとあっさりしたものも<CR>メニューにあればって思ったこともあるけど
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, I do sometimes wish they'd have some simpler food on the menu.
records.en: Now that you mention it, I do sometimes wish they'd have some simpler food on the menu.

records.jp: それってもう映画のお供っていうより<CR>映画が食事のお供になってる気が
records.en_original: But that's not really a snack to go with the movie anymore—more like dinner and a movie.
records.en: But that's not really a snack to go with the movie anymore—more like dinner and a movie.

records.jp: よーし、余ったご飯ないか聞きにいこっと
records.en_original: Okay, let's go see if we have any leftover rice!
records.en: Okay, let's go see if we have any leftover rice!

records.jp: まぁ、いっか。<CR>おにぎり握るの、結構楽しいし
records.en_original: Sure, why not? Making rice balls is fun anyway.
records.en: Sure, why not? Making rice balls is fun anyway.

records.jp: （ミュージカル出てる俳優さんってすごいなぁ）
records.en_original: (The actors in musicals are really amazing.)
records.en: (The actors in musicals are really amazing.)

records.jp: （演技だけじゃなくて、歌ったり、踊ったり。<CR>よくこんな動けるよなぁ）
records.en_original: (Not only do they act, they sing and dance too. How do they do it?)
records.en: (Not only do they act, they sing and dance too. How do they do it?)

records.jp: （うわ、めっちゃ真剣に見てる！）
records.en_original: (Wow, she's really into it!)
records.en: (Wow, she's really into it!)

records.jp: どうだった？　日菜子さん
records.en_original: What did you think, Hinako?
records.en: What did you think, Hinako-san?

records.jp: 主演の女優さん、多分バレエ経験者。<CR>少しクセが出てる。足の伸ばし方とか
records.en_original: The lead actress is probably a ballet dancer. You can tell from the way she moves her legs.
records.en: The lead actress is probably a ballet dancer. You can tell from the way she moves her legs.

records.jp: （あれは同業者を見る目だったのか）
records.en_original: (Is that her professional opinion?)
records.en: (Is that her professional opinion?)

records.jp: でも、全く違うジャンルのダンスを<CR>ここまで踊れるのはすごいと思う
records.en_original: But I was amazed how well she was able to dance in a completely different genre.
records.en: But I was amazed how well she was able to dance in a completely different genre.

records.jp: 私だったらできるか自信ない。<CR>怪我してなかったとしても
records.en_original: I'm not sure I could do that, even if I wasn't injured.
records.en: I'm not sure I could do that, even if I wasn't injured.

records.jp: いっぱい練習したんだろうなぁ
records.en_original: She must have practiced a lot.
records.en: She must have practiced a lot.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: そうだよね。<CR>私も、バレエ以外のことも頑張ろう
records.en_original: That's true. I think I should put some effort into things other than ballet too.
records.en: That's true. I think I should put some effort into things other than ballet too.

records.jp: 一見難しそうに見えても、<CR>大体のことは練習すればできるようになる
records.en_original: Even if something looks difficult at first, most of the time all it takes is practice.
records.en: Even if something looks difficult at first, most of the time all it takes is practice.

records.jp: それがバレエから教わったことだから
records.en_original: That's what I learned from ballet.
records.en: That's what I learned from ballet.

records.jp: （前向きになれたみたいでよかった）
records.en_original: (She sounds optimistic. That's good.)
records.en: (She sounds optimistic. That's good.)

records.jp: ミュージカルやってる日菜子さん見たい！
records.en_original: I wanna see you perform in a musical, Hinako!
records.en: I wanna see you perform in a musical, Hinako-san!

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: ここまで激しいのはあれだけど……あの女優さん<CR>みたいに、バレエの経験活かせるかもしれないじゃん
records.en_original: One that's less intense than this movie, maybe... But I'm sure you'd be able to use your ballet experience, just like that actress.
records.en: One that's less intense than this movie, maybe... But I'm sure you'd be able to use your ballet experience, just like that actress.

records.jp: それに、私はダンスのことよくわからないけどさ、<CR>他のジャンルに触れたら意外な発見があるかもよ？
records.en_original: I don't know much about dance, but if you try out other genres, you might find something you like!
records.en: I don't know much about dance, but if you try out other genres, you might find something you like!

records.jp: たしかに、できなさそうだからって決めつけて<CR>手を出さないのはもったいないよね
records.en_original: You're right. It'd be a shame to never try something because I thought I couldn't do it.
records.en: You're right. It'd be a shame to never try something because I thought I couldn't do it.

records.jp: でも、さすがに歌ったりセリフを言ったりするのは<CR>ちょっと恥ずかしいな……
records.en_original: I'd be too embarassed to sing and say all the lines, though...
records.en: I'd be too embarassed to sing and say all the lines, though...

records.jp: 日菜子さんなら文化祭の劇の主役とか<CR>やったことあるんじゃないの？
records.en_original: But Hinako, weren't you the lead in the school play?
records.en: But Hinako-san, weren't you the lead in the school play?

records.jp: バレエをしてたから舞台映えしそうって<CR>クラスの人に勧められたりしてさ
records.en_original: I bet all your classmates were excited to see you on stage since you used to do ballet.
records.en: I bet all your classmates were excited to see you on stage since you used to do ballet.

records.jp: あっ……
records.en_original: Eh...
records.en: Eh...

records.jp: 声の演技もできるなら完璧じゃん。<CR>これはやるっきゃないね
records.en_original: Once you learned your lines, you'd be perfect! You've gotta do it!
records.en: Once you learned your lines, you'd be perfect! You've gotta do it!

records.jp: 一旦忘れて、お願いだから
records.en_original: Oh, just give it up already...
records.en: Oh, just give it up already...

records.jp: 次は何見る？
records.en_original: So, what should we watch next?
records.en: So, what should we watch next?

records.jp: 特に思いつかないから、愛央が好きなのでいいよ
records.en_original: I can't think of anything, so whatever you like.
records.en: I can't think of anything, so whatever you like.

records.jp: 好きなの、ね
records.en_original: Whatever I like...
records.en: Whatever I like...

records.jp: （いやぁ、何度見ても最高！<CR>「劇場版　屍神の法則」）
records.en_original: (It's gotta be The Death God Theory: The Movie! I could watch this one a million times!)
records.en: (It's gotta be The Death God Theory: The Movie! I could watch this one a million times!)

records.jp: （好きなのでいいって言われたから、<CR>本当に好きなの見せちゃったけど、大丈夫かな）
records.en_original: (I don't know if Hinako will like it... But she did say we can watch whatever I want!)
records.en: (I don't know if Hinako will like it... But she did say we can watch whatever I want!)

records.jp: どうだった？　一応、原作漫画を読んでなくても<CR>分かるようにはなってるはずなんだけど……
records.en_original: What did you think? They tried to make it so you can follow the story without reading the original manga, but...
records.en: What did you think? They tried to make it so you can follow the story without reading the original manga, but...

records.jp: 用語はちょっと難しくてよくわからなかった
records.en_original: The jargon made it kind of hard to follow...
records.en: The jargon made it kind of hard to follow...

records.jp: たはは……
records.en_original: Eheh...
records.en: Eheh...

records.jp: でもアクションシーンはかっこよかったし、<CR>最後の鏡花のセリフ、すごくいいなって思ったよ
records.en_original: But the action scenes were cool, and I thought Kyoka's lines at the end were great.
records.en: But the action scenes were cool, and I thought Kyoka's lines at the end were great.

records.jp: ありがとう
records.en_original: Thanks.
records.en: Thanks.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: For what?
records.en: For what?

records.jp: 好きなものを褒められるとさ、<CR>自分のことみたいに嬉しいじゃん？
records.en_original: I dunno, it just feels nice when someone likes the same stuff I like.
records.en: I dunno, it just feels nice when someone likes the same stuff I like.

records.jp: そっか……私にとってのバレエと一緒だね
records.en_original: I see... That's how ballet is for me.
records.en: I see... That's how ballet is for me.

records.jp: 続編もあるんだけど……
records.en_original: Wait till you see the sequel...
records.en: Wait till you see the sequel...

records.jp: それはちょっと待って
records.en_original: Maybe we should save that for another time.
records.en: Maybe we should save that for another time.

records.jp: あ、ごめん！　調子乗っちゃって
records.en_original: Ah, sorry! I just got caught up in the moment.
records.en: Ah, sorry! I just got caught up in the moment.

records.jp: 先に原作の方を読みたいな
records.en_original: I'd rather read the original first.
records.en: I'd rather read the original first.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……！
records.en_original: Hinako...!
records.en: Hinako-san...!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
